title: Full Stack Web Developer
description: Designs, develops, and maintains end-to-end web applications, encompassing responsive frontends, scalable REST/GraphQL APIs, relational and NoSQL databases, and containerized deployment workflows.

title: Data Scientist
description: Applies statistical modeling, exploratory data analysis, and predictive machine learning algorithms to turn raw structured and unstructured data into strategic insights and decision systems.

title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer
description: Architects resilient cloud infrastructure, builds automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, manages Kubernetes clusters, and guarantees high availability and monitoring across environments.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Builds and productionizes deep learning, NLP, and predictive ML models, architecting feature pipelines, distributed training, and ultra-low latency model serving APIs.

title: Backend Engineer
description: Specializes in high-performance server-side architectures, microservices, database schema design and optimization, transaction management, and robust authentication layers.

title: Frontend Engineer
description: Builds fast, accessible, and delightful interactive user interfaces with modern reactive component frameworks, client-side state management, and optimized responsive layouts.

title: Cyber Security Analyst
description: Protects organizational assets by identifying vulnerabilities, implementing authentication and OWASP defensive standards, monitoring network traffic, and incident remediation.

title: Data Engineer
description: Constructs reliable data pipelines, automated ETL workflows, warehouse data modeling, and streaming infrastructure to support large-scale analytical workloads.
